tho yas tv atikrānta-bhāvanīyaḥ / Tasya citta-pratisarga eko'rthaḥ
/ Sapta-vidhā–asya prānta-bhūmi-prajñā / Tatra madhumatīṃ bhūmiṃ sākṣāt-kurvato
brāhmaṇasya sthānino devāḥ sattva-viśuddhim anupaśyantaḥ sthānair upanimantrayante--
bho iha–āsyatām, iha ramyatām kamanīyo'yaṃ bhogaḥ, kamanīyā–iyaṃ kanyā, rasāyanam
idaṃ jarā-mṛtyū
1715 bādhate, vaihāyasam idaṃ yānam, amī kalpa-drumāḥ, puṇyā mandākinī,
siddhā maharṣayaḥ, uttamā anukūlā apsarasaḥ, divye śrotra-cakṣuṣī, vajra-upamaḥ kāyaḥ,
sva-guṇaiḥ sarvam idam upārjitam āyuṣmatā pratipadyatām, idam akṣayam ajaram amara-
sthānaṃ devānāṃ priyam iti / Evam abhidhīyamānaḥ saṅga-doṣān bhāvayet-- ghore
